name: How do I choose the right size and length for a toilet grab bar?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right size and length for a toilet grab bar?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right size and length for a toilet grab bar depends on the user's height, reach, and the bathroom's layout. Common lengths range from 12 to 36 inches. A shorter bar might be suitable for vertical assistance, while a longer bar offers more surface area for horizontal support. The diameter is also important; it should be comfortable to grasp. We recommend an on-site assessment to measure and select the most appropriate dimensions that optimize safety and functionality for the specific user and space.
